review: Root reviewed the full mathematical arguments and decisive original interfaces. The global-norm reviewer independently checked thin periodization and Gaussian estimates; the geometry reviewer independently checked type-I irreducibility, polarization and characteristic-zero descent.

thin_lower_bound: The original period lattice, integral unimodular imaginary form and isotropic semicharacter are retained.
Real isotropic E-stable saturation, exact dual-frequency lattice, anisotropic Voronoi covering and determinant maximization were reviewed.
Ordinary-derivative factorials and the Hermitian effective column u-qb+iq a/2 were checked; columns of distinct determinant blocks are disjoint.
Absolute Gaussian overlap bounds justify unfolding before character orthogonality; all frequency and affine-lattice tails retain original dimensions.
Original GCauchy parameters imply every numerical hypothesis; the actual rank hypothesis is supplied by Ranks, not inferred from fr>=2.
Half-level basis cardinality, probability norm, evaluation scalar and constant metric transfer on the same component were checked.
type_one_rigidity: Clifford restriction and the three-cycle residual trace contradiction retain separate decomposition and inertia elements and include ell=3.
Connected Zariski monodromy is reductive; its scalar center and derived subgroup prove irreducibility on the infinite cyclotomic kernel.
Original normalized point and full arithmetic-point classicality give automorphy over the same auxiliary CM field.
Thorne Theorem 6.1 was checked in the primary accepted paper; no residual image hypothesis is required.
The polarized adjoint action is exactly X -> -J X^t J, including its trace line. All characteristic-zero restrictions are justified by corestriction.
The full finite-algebra crystalline comparison includes delta nonresonance at e=1; away-ell inertia uses the full finite character chi, not merely its residual character.
degenerate_fibres: The common stabilizer equals the actual coordinate subgroup; its quotient factorization has real Jacobian one, including imaginary diagonal coordinates.
Equal block-antidiagonal moduli interpolate all prefix products between original nonzero leading minors.
One exterior determinant bounds moved dual pairings, yielding the exact upper, central and skew coordinate boxes.
The normalized Gram volume is the original projected exterior volume: ambient dimension k+1, projection rank at least k-1, and division by |D_j| exactly once.
The central isometry has absolute determinant one; the pre-existing GV8 therefore applies without an additional Jacobian.
All box powers and constants were checked; transport to arbitrary right translates produces exactly the inverse stabilizer scalar.

limitations: No uniform integral Selmer or conormal-length bound is deduced.
The fibre estimate still needs its orbital-operator consumer and global arithmetic sum.
Point-height comparison, final section remainder and any separately assumed numerical-family construction remain.
No Lean build or automated proof of the arithmetic theorems is claimed.
